verdict.rationale: Docs show BVNK exposes a REST API for wallets, transfers, channels and payouts that hides on-chain mechanics (e.g., wallet, rule, and transfer endpoints), so nodes/gas are clearly abstracted. However, evidence only shows a Hawk-authenticated REST API and one CLI repo, not official client libraries/SDKs in multiple languages as the story specifies. Missing for 10: documented multi-language SDKs/client libraries, explicit statement that developers never touch node/gas mechanics.
